item.description: A mural inspired by artwork created by Prince Albert students was unveiled Friday at the City’s water treatment plant, highlighting clean water and environmental stewardship. item.description: Prince Albert officials are developing a housing strategy aimed at addressing a significant shortage of affordable housing in the city.
